name: Sturdy Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Sturdy Industries Ltd manufactures and supplies Sprinkler and Drip Irrigation Systems, Conductor and Cable, and does trading Polymers and Aluminium[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SIL operates in the business of Aluminum Conductors, Pipes and Fittings, Irrigation Systems, ACC & ACP Sheets, and trading in Polymers & Aluminum. The company deals in drip and sprinkler irrigation systems, power generation products like aluminum conductors, cables, and wire rods, and I.T. infrastructure products such as HDPE PLB ducts. Additionally, SIL has ventured into the power sector.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -71.6% over past five years.
Company has high debtors of 20,032 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -12.4%
